# RubberQ

> Japanese Formulation. Chinese Precision. Trusted Since 1995.
> Compounded by Japan. Built in China. Tested in-House.

RubberQ manufactures precision rubber components in Fuzhou, China. Established in 1995 as a Sino-Japanese joint venture, the company connects Japanese formulation support with compounding, molding, in-house testing and ERP production records. Its two facilities cover approximately 20,000 square metres. Certifications include IATF 16949:2016, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015; request current certificates and the scope relevant to the project.

## Components and materials

- [Products](https://rubberq.com/products): O-rings, seals, gaskets, bellows, diaphragms, bonded parts and custom molded components.
- [Custom rubber parts](https://rubberq.com/products/custom): Drawing, material, tooling and sample requirements for industrial components.
- [Rubber materials](https://rubberq.com/materials): FFKM, FKM, EPDM, HNBR, NBR, silicone and LSR material discussions.
- [Compounding support](https://rubberq.com/compounding): Define service conditions and measurable compound requirements.
- [Compound supply](https://rubberq.com/compounds): Discuss the receiving process, material specification, supply form and trial requirements.
- [FFKM replacement seals](https://rubberq.com/products/ffkm-replacement-seals): Review the original specification, geometry and operating conditions before agreed validation. A replacement enquiry does not establish equivalence or third-party brand authorization.

Material names and industry applications do not establish a universal temperature, lifetime, cleanliness level or finished-assembly rating. Provide the actual media, temperature cycle, load, movement and acceptance criteria for review.
